Copy catalogue configuration from one business into another: products with their prices, attached items and differential prices, or coupons. For standing up a second book that should sell what the first one sells without rebuilding it by hand.

A copy, not a link — the objects are independent once transferred, and editing one afterwards does not change the other.

## Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/coupons/copy`](/help/developers/api-reference/transfers/copy-coupons-from-another-business-into-this-one) | Copy coupons from another business into this one |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/products/copy`](/help/developers/api-reference/transfers/copy-the-catalog) | Copy the catalog (products/prices/attached/differential) from another business |
